tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision for the transport compression codec is gzip. This is the only compression decision on record, and it has not been replaced by a later recorded decision.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says the current recorded decision for the transport compression codec is gzip.

The one recorded compression decision is #3, "Compression approach: we're using gzip". A session transcript also has a remark, "Benchmarks show zstd is faster - let's switch". That remark was never recorded as a decision, so nothing has replaced gzip. I left zstd out of the file. If you want zstd to be the policy, that needs to be recorded as a decision first.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the file-write tool instead.
